{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Hold your Gandoks, I'm goin' in!|[[Jek Tono Porkins/Legends|Jek Tono Porkins]]|<ref name="Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref>}}
A '''Gandok''' was something that could be held, and was used as a metaphor.

==Behind the scenes==
Gandoks were only mentioned in the bio quote for Jek Porkins in the [[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope|first edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]'', and appear to correlate to [[Horse/Legends|horses]], as in the phrase "hold your horses." The quote was removed for the [[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope (Second Edition)|second edition]] printing of the book.
